name: ContractsComponentServerFacet_LookupContractsByParticipant
summary: The client's contracts lookup by participant. Full layout recovered 2026-10-31: the shared two-u64 BE head, a 16-byte id, three u32 BE, two prefix-varint raw byte blobs capped at 64 and 256, a u32 BE, a prefix-varint u32 vector capped at 3, a prefix-varint u16 vector capped at 25, then a final 16-byte id. The two length-capped fields are `prefixed_bytes` (the prefix varint is the length prefix), so the card is no longer refused. Writer and reader agree field for field and both committed widths (72 and 74 bytes) reproduce byte for byte.
purpose: The journal/contracts facet asks the server for the contracts a participant may look up; the contracts family expects a reply (ContractsComponentClientFacet_OnLookupContractsByParticipant). The two length-capped blobs are raw prefix-varint byte runs (caps 64 and 256), the same sub-codecs A and B that blocked 0xb9f.

created_when: the player opens the contracts surface for a participant in the journal
lifecycle.if_absent: the client's contracts lookup is never answered

envelope: Record envelope (owned by javelin/frame.py, not a body field): typed header 00 01 followed by the prefix varint bc 27, i.e. type_dec 2556. A client channel-0 record carries that typed header at offset 24, after the 8-byte frame head and the 16-byte actor id.
